title: journal_<op>.json
description: Operation journal for multi-file changes (reset, profile apply, import). A file left in status 'running' means the process died mid-operation: Invoke-OpReconciliation restores the golden from the recorded backup at the next start. 'recovered' is written after such a rollback.

op.description: Operation name, also part of the file name (journal_<op>.json).

started.description: ISO timestamp when the operation started.

steps.description: Ordered steps with their outcome; path points at the file the step produced or backed up.

step.description: Step name, e.g. backup / write-golden / verify.

path.description: File this step wrote or backed up (may be empty).
